messages.text: Hi Michal, good to see you back. What can I help with today?

I got a message today : "
We’ve been notified that a parcel has been posted to you from Helium Deploy in Netherlands.

Just to let you know, it’s likely there will be a Customs charge to pay for this item, due to the declared value of it."

Yes, that's genuine, Michal. Your two miners left our Rotterdam warehouse on October 12 and are in transit to (address hidden), estimated delivery October 19. Tracking: (tracking link hidden)

Since B., UK deliveries can carry import VAT and duty, charged by the carrier on delivery. That's the recipient's to pay and we don't collect it at checkout, so I can't quote the exact figure your customs office will raise.
I thought the 60$ fees i already paid was that

That $63.98 was shipping, Michal, two standard ground charges on the order. Tax on the order came to zero, so nothing towards UK import VAT or duty was collected.

The carrier bills that separately when the parcel lands, and it's the recipient's to pay. I can't quote the figure, HMRC sets it off the declared value.
So i have to pay what in cash when it comes?

Not usually cash at the door. The carrier sends a text or email with a payment link, and you settle it online before they deliver.

UK import VAT is 20% of the declared value, plus the carrier's own handling fee. The goods on that parcel were $499, so expect roughly that order of VAT, converted to pounds, plus the fee. HMRC and the carrier set the exact number, not us, so treat that as a ballpark and go by the notice they send you.
So this becomes very much troublesome and i think i will need to find something within the uk that sells these?

I get the frustration, Michal, nobody likes a bill at the door. Honestly though, it's the same for any UK buyer: anything coming from outside the UK carries that 20% at the border, including from a UK reseller who imported it, they just build it into the price.

These are already in transit to you, with UK plugs, and we support them from here. The follow-up parcel with the Overclocking add-on is low value, so any charge on it would be small.

No problem. Delivery is estimated October 19, and the notice from the carrier will tell you the exact amount to pay.

One thing I'd like to understand, since you mentioned looking for a UK seller: was it the size of the charge that bothered you, or that it turned up as a surprise after you'd paid?
